dossier.identity: restorative support operator who heals with a precise beam and a hardlight comfort dome, keeping a squad steady alongside her cat-shaped assist drone Nexi
dossier.selectionRationale: the sheet labels glint "operator / support"; the role mapping takes the nearest role, operator. chosen as the single-target and barrier support: a direct mender beam and a linkable comfort dome, distinct from eider's haste tempo and lumen's channelled healing zone. nexi is the sheet's always-nearby companion and is modelled as a passive carrier at rank 5.
dossier.weaponConcept: signal rifle (restorative support platform: non-lethal stabilised output, swappable cells and a long-range scope; paired with the Nexi assist drone)

lore.backstory: former horizon protocol field medic who learned that the quietest way to stop a firefight is to make everyone on her side impossible to kill. she rebuilt a decommissioned relay rifle to carry heal-signals instead of rounds and adopted a stray assist drone, Nexi, which now follows her through every sector and purrs whenever someone she is healing stops shaking.
lore.syndicateRecord: listed for diverting medical relay bandwidth to civilian districts and for returning three corporate-issued assist drones to their rightful strays.
lore.psychProfile: warm, unhurried and quietly stubborn; speaks softly, checks on everyone twice and never leaves a patient mid-treatment.
lore.combatQuote: “brighter days. together. stay close, nexi will keep count.”

signature.stock: Deploys a hardlight comfort dome (carrier: 300 hp, shootable) up to 7 m (700 cm) away: radius 2.5 m (250 cm), lasts 5 s (150 ticks), pulses every 2.5 s (75 ticks) and gives allies inside a 90 barrier. Cost 36 · windup 0.5 s (15 ticks) · cooldown 20 s (600 ticks).
signature.interpretation: Numbers follow the roster conventions and extend the concept sheet; every guessed field is listed as a hypothesis in the form behaviour. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.

payloadUnits.damage: points per hit or pulse; sequence describes splitting
payloadUnits.statusAmount: percentage points unless a state definition specifies otherwise

counterplay: Break or out-range the dome; collapse the zone with area damage before the second pulse.

forms.name: soothing entry
forms.description: Allies inside are cleansed of slowed, rooted, silenced and bleeding on the first pulse.

forms.name: twin comfort
forms.description: A second dome stands beside the first (count 2) and the two are linked: an ally inside either dome shares 20% of the damage it takes with allies in the other.

iconFamily.subject: a bold cat head beside a single chunky healing beam spark
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Glint. Theme: mender beam. Subject: a bold cat head beside a single chunky healing beam spark. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
